useful_delta: Designed lineage-preserving epistemic convergence above Agent Network coordination convergence: immutable returns -> semantic atoms -> scoped/authority-aware clusters -> contradiction graph -> pre/post coverage audit -> Steward adjudication -> versioned crystallized records/heads -> compiled Canon/Working Sets -> value/cost metrics. Added explicit promotion/retirement, deduplication, contradiction and anti-limitation rules.
facts: Big Picture requires deduplication, reconciliation, stable-rule promotion, Canon/Working-Set compaction, lineage preservation, non-destructive retirement and head updates.
Anti-Limitation requires aggressive independent parallel cognition, convergence not averaging, coverage audit, hidden-conservatism critics, progress metrics and replanning after batches.
Survival Set requires source reopening, negative knowledge, explicit parent/steward integration, authority separation, canonical recovery and no silent invariant loss.
Agent Network v3 already supplies coordination convergence events such as scope overlap, dependency change and informational impact, but is derived/read-only and does not decide semantic truth.
Current blueprint and return contract already make worker results inputs to a single owning integrator with explicit consumption states; return existence is not integration/Human Acceptance.
Concurrent BIG-02 and BIG-01 returns propose lineaged Product Memory/Canon compaction and clause-level METHOD_HEAD supersession. They are worker evidence, not self-promoted authority.

architecture.principle: Separate coordination convergence (who overlaps/depends/changed) from epistemic convergence (what knowledge is equivalent/conflicting/reusable/promotable). Runtime events never auto-promote truth; semantic compaction never replaces live collision detection.
algorithm: 0_INPUT_FREEZE
Capture batch watermark, exact return/source ids, authority refs and coverage baseline. Late returns merge later as deltas.
1_HARVEST
Read immutable returns/evidence; never rewrite source returns during compaction.
2_ATOMIZE
Create stable atoms: FACT, PROPOSAL, DECISION_CANDIDATE, INVARIANT, NEGATIVE_KNOWLEDGE, FAILURE_SIGNATURE, OWNER_CAPABILITY, TEST_RECIPE, OPEN_QUESTION, EVIDENCE_REF.
3_NORMALIZE
Attach scope, layer, authority class, epistemic state, lifecycle state, freshness/revalidation, privacy, evidence, dependencies and falsifiers. Keep axes independent.
4_CLUSTER
Group semantic equivalents/overlaps while retaining every source node. Broader/narrower or different-scope claims stay distinct.
5_RELATION_GRAPH
Add SUPPORTS, DUPLICATES, REFINES, BROADENS, NARROWS, DEPENDS_ON, CONFLICTS_WITH, SUPERSEDES_CANDIDATE, ORTHOGONAL_TO edges.
6_COVERAGE_PRE
Map clusters to Big Picture, Survival Set, JOB deliverables, human goal/FOCUS, authority/privacy and negative knowledge before compression.
7_ADJUDICATE
Owning Steward decides PROMOTE, KEEP_CANDIDATE, SPLIT_BY_SCOPE, FOLLOWUP_REQUIRED, REJECT, RETIRE_STALE, SUPERSEDE or ESCALATE_REAL_BOUNDARY using evidence/authority/scope/falsifiers.
8_CRYSTALLIZE
Append versioned records plus integration receipt; move heads/pointers instead of destructively rewriting history.
9_COMPILE
Compile task-specific Canon/Working Set/Method views from crystallized records; optimize retrieval/execution cost, not arbitrary shortness.
10_COVERAGE_POST
Diff post-compaction coverage against PRE. Any dropped critical invariant, hidden conflict or lost negative knowledge fails the gate.
11_MEASURE_REPLAN
Record unique delta, duplication, conflicts, coverage, lineage and integration cost; use results to choose more/different workers or execution.
architecture.incremental_rule: Stable semantic ids/clusters make convergence incrementally rerunnable; late returns can merge without replaying the whole batch.

deduplication.duplicate_rule: Keep all source nodes; aliases point to one semantic cluster. Count corroboration only when sources are genuinely independent.
deduplication.clone_warning: Raw worker agreement is not independent evidence; worker/source diversity must be tracked separately from vote count.

order: apply authority hierarchy without treating authority as evidence
ask human only at real value/consent/policy boundary
contradiction_handling.rule: Unresolved minority findings remain explicit conflict nodes. Consensus never silently deletes a well-evidenced contradiction.

promotion_requires: test/falsifier or revalidation rule where relevant
promotion_retirement.retirement_law: Retirement is lineaged with scope/reason/evidence/replacement. Absence from a newer summary is never retirement.
promotion_retirement.authority_guard: Crystallized/Canonical does not imply Human Accepted, Current or Served.

crystallized_intelligence.definition: Reusable learning that survived evidence, contradiction handling, scope/authority classification and explicit integration; not raw transcript volume or majority vote.

artifacts.CRYSTAL_GRAPH: Immutable semantic records plus typed relations to returns/evidence/decisions/incidents/method/memory.
artifacts.CRYSTAL_LEDGER: Steward receipts for promote/reject/split/retire/supersede with baselines, reasons and coverage digest.
artifacts.CRYSTAL_HEAD: Small versioned/rollback-addressable pointer to currently active reusable record set for a domain/project.
artifacts.COMPACTION_RECEIPT: Input watermark, cluster/conflict counts, promotions/retirements, PRE/POST coverage digests, omitted nuance and metrics.

crystallized_intelligence.history_rule: Heads are compact projections. Raw evidence and retired/superseded records remain reopenable.

coverage_audit.gate: Critical UNEXPLORED, silent N/A or post-compaction regression blocks complete-enough claims. Percentages may summarize but never hide critical gaps.
coverage_audit.round_trip: Every compaction has PRE and POST coverage digests; their diff is a regression test for silent invariant drop.

scale_model.pipeline: returns -> local semantic clusters -> domain compactors/critics -> cross-domain contradiction/coverage -> single owning Steward promotion
scale_model.serial_boundary: Only canonical promotion/head movement needs single ownership per domain. Single Steward does not imply serial cognition.

anti_limitation: All workers must finish before synthesis
False: harvest/cluster/audit incrementally by watermark; late returns merge as deltas. Final promotion can wait for required evidence without idling.
Single Steward means serial reasoning
False: only final adjudication/head movement is single-owner; preparatory reasoning can fan out.
Dedup means deletion
False: dedup semantic views while retaining sources/evidence relations.
Consensus means truth
False: evidence independence, scope and falsifiability dominate vote count.
Safety requires manual review of every step
False: automate reversible/read-only normalization, clustering, coverage and metrics; gate authority-changing promotion/risky writes.
Good compaction means shortest text
False: optimize retrieval cost subject to critical retention, lineage and uncertainty.
Every contradiction needs human
False: most scope/time/evidence/authority conflicts are resolvable mechanically or via verifier; human only at true value/consent boundary.
18 chats is a scale ceiling
False: hierarchical compaction/domain stewardship makes batch size an operational parameter.
Runtime convergence equals knowledge convergence
False: coordination events and epistemic reconciliation have different semantics/authority.
More workers automatically means more progress
False: use marginal unique delta, coverage/risk discovery and integration cost.
metrics: Novel non-duplicate atoms surviving review or materially changing follow-up.
New covered cells plus critical gaps discovered.
Duplicate semantic atoms / total atoms, separate from independent corroboration.
Material conflicts discovered that otherwise remained hidden.
Resolved/split material conflicts / material conflicts found.
Promoted material records with reopenable provenance / promoted material records; target 100%.
Post-compaction critical coverage / pre-compaction; target 100%, any loss blocks.
Active compiled footprint before/after, meaningful only with retention/coverage.
Sum worker active durations / batch wall time; descriptive, not value by itself.
Steward/reconciler effort plus conflict repair plus parallelization rework.
Unique delta plus coverage/risk contribution from one added worker / execution plus incremental integration cost.
Redundancy plus collisions plus stale-baseline rework plus integration overhead.
metric_policy: No single scalar is authority. Increase parallelism while marginal workers add distinct coverage/risk reduction faster than integration entropy/cost; diversify/decompose/stop when duplicates rise and marginal useful delta collapses.
parent_sequence: harvest available BIG returns without human courier
target source reopening/critics for critical gaps/conflicts

conflicts: Use hierarchy/diversity/marginal metrics, not default serialization.
Immutable sources plus conflict edges plus PRE/POST coverage plus omitted-nuance receipt.
Keep epistemic/lifecycle/authority axes separate; Product Memory/Canon never self-promotes Current/Human Accepted/Served.
Single owner only at canonical head movement; parallelize preparatory convergence.
